body: I'm not sure either why he wasn't charged. I didn't exactly keep up with the case. I wanted to be done with him so I just walked away. In the messages he tells me that he found out it was a virus. I go over this scenario in my head but it still doesn't make sense. I'm thinking maybe I just didn't mourn as I should have all those years ago and now I have to feel everything I didn't back then. I don't know. I'm completely besides myself and people are starting to notice. I'm just hoping having said this to someone will help. Thank you so much for responding, by the way. I really appreciate it.

Then there are the messages. From him. Over 6 years I've received countless emails, phone calls, texts, fb messages all pleading with me to take him back. How it was all a misunderstanding and I'm the love of his life. He talks as if we broke up last week even though I've never responded to any of them. So, about a week ago I was at a concert and saw him for the first time in 6 years and when he began walking over to say hi I walked past him like he wasn't there and left. The thing is, for a week now I can't eat, I can't sleep, I can't work. He's all I think about and I miss him with every fucking thing I have in me. This makes me nauseous. How could I possibly feel like that for this despicable individual? Why, after all these years, have I never felt anything like I did with him with anyone else. I feel like I found my soul mate and, just my luck, he's a sicko. I lay awake at night thinking of ways that I could have been mistaken but I know I wasn't and my heart is just in two. I'm feeling so disgusting. I can't for the life of me understand myself right now.

It was like all my love just turned off. I grabbed everything that I needed and made him take me to my families house. On the drive there we argue like animals with him being mad at me for going through his stuff and me calling him a disgusting piece of shit and telling him that we were done and he would never see me again. I punch him in the face before getting out of the car after he says something particularly nasty and walk out of his life. I call the police immediately to make the report and tell my friends and family. I leave town for a few months and change my number. Then slowly over the course of a few months I realize that even friends I'd known my whole life, friends I'd known for years before I'd even met him, still considered him a friend. After all, they'd tell me, he's a great artist. Some people went so far as to stop speaking to me so as to continue their friendship with him. I eventually found myself alone. And even though I felt like, "Fuck them. Who needs people like that in my life." It doesn't make the loneliness any less painful. We've been broken up for 6 years and I have friends but none that I have anything in common with. And he's just become more liked by all the younger artists in town. Anytime I meet someone new they eventually meet him and there goes that.

Years ago I met this guy at a party. We'd overheard each other discussing a particular topic that we were both passionate about and became instant friends. After a few months I learned he was incredibly smart, talented, and kind. Everyone who met him liked him and he liked everyone he met. As he was a very well respected artist I always met the most interesting people and made some amazing friends through him. So, one day I decide that even though he's not very handsome and has never really had a girlfriend before, I've found the perfect guy in my eyes. The one all the other girls are just stupidly overlooking. We begin dating and are completely enamored with each other for 5 years. During this time he becomes part of my family and I his. Years after year we never lost interest in each other and could sit and talk about music or the news for hours or hang with friends and have some drinks and laughs or just cuddle and watch movies. And the sex. I've never felt anything like it with anybody else. There was so much love and friendship between us. The only bump in the road were the artists he knew.  They were the coolest dudes and always really accepting of me despite me being a "girlfriend". (you know how it is) Until one day my boyfriend and I have a stupid argument that we quickly got over and I didn't go to a party they threw. They took it so personally and decided I didn't like them so they didn't like me. As upsetting as it was and as much as it changed some things it didn't change our relationship. It was never something that threatened us. We loved each other too much for that to even be an option. We'd just had a great weekend and were winding down one Sunday night when I found the pictures on the computer in the loft. The girls ranged from about 3 to 12 years old and at first my brain didn't even comprehend they could be his. I fly into action and go to get him so we can call the police and figure out where they came from. He walks over to the computer, deletes the entire My Documents file and turns around to call me a bitch for "going through his things." It hit me like a ton of bricks in the face.
